'''Metellos''' was the fourth of seven [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Metellos system/Legends|Metellos system]] of the [[Corusca sector/Legends|Corusca sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region. The planet orbited one [[Star/Legends|star]], also called [[Metellos (star)|Metellos]], and in turn was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by three [[Moon/Legends|moons]].

==Description==
Metellos, also known as "the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that wasn't," was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Metellos (star)|Metellos]] in the [[Metellos system/Legends|Metellos system]]<ref name="CATCW" /> of the [[Corusca sector/Legends|Corusca sector]]<ref name="sector" /> in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was located on the [[Metellos Trade Route/Legends|Metellos Trade Route]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] on which it lay between the [[Norkronia system/Legends|Norkronia system]] and Coruscant. A traditional [[Metellos-Ilum hyperspace route/Legends|uninterrupted hyperjump]] to [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] was made from Metellos, but could only be accomplished by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who were strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and was kept secret by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="TEA" /> A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] on Metellos lasted 24 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] lasted 361 standard days.<ref name="CATCW" />

[[File:MorideboDistrict.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Moridebo District]] on Metellos]]
A terrestrial world with a diameter of 12,600 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], Metellos possessed three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and featured a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], temperate climate, and standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. With the exception of a few seas and [[Desert/Legends|desert]] wastelands, the surface of Metellos was entirely urbanized. Seventeen large [[stratablock]]s were present on Metellos, and structures such as these reached heights as great as one kilometer above the planet's surface, tapering off into single-story structures. Many tracts, especially those situated far away from the stratablocks, were shabby, environmentally toxic, and occupied by diseased squatters.<ref name="CATCW" />

In spite of its problems, Metellos was considered to be a highly developed planet.<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> Metellos was governed by a bureaucracy and exported business services and advanced technology while importing foodstuffs and office supplies. More than 1,000 floating cities, constructed by the wealthy executives of the planet to compensate for overcrowding, drifted 1,200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above housing precincts. Designers modeled these cities after the [[Ithorian Herdship|herd cities]] of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], though in reality the gridlike Metellean constructs were obviously quite different from their inspirations.<ref name="CATCW" />

==History==
Metellos was colonized between [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]] and [[26,000 BBY/Legends|26,000 BBY]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who traveled from Coruscant in [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Galactic Republic formed later, and as the government took shape over subsequent centuries, many merchants, dignitaries, and prospectors found operating on Coruscant more convenient than doing so on Metellos, which required an additional [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump to the galactic west. For a time, Metellos hosted a diverse community of hyperspace explorers who hoped to discover a western counterpart to the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] that would make Metellos a new economic center. Although the Metellos Trade Route proved disappointing, Metellos persisted in its efforts, leading to economic recession that lasted for centuries.<ref name="CATCW" />

Metellos was incorporated into the Galactic Republic by approximately [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Too proud to request aid from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the rulers of Metellos exploited their world's resources to obtain temporary capital, and in the absence of measures to ensure environmental balance, unchecked population growth occurred.<ref name="CATCW" /> During the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the navy of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] traveled to Metellos from Coruscant.<ref name="TEA" />

At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the Metellean elite resided in floating [[City/Legends|cities]] in the upper atmosphere of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. They polluted the orbit with their junk, which created a large field of debris.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|A Field of Debris}}</ref>

In [[700 BBY]], the directors of Metellos's most powerful corporations created clean, airborne cities for the use of the wealthy and well-connected. As the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] rose to power, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] granted the ruling executives of Metellos a stake in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].<ref name="CATCW" />

[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] governance led to the establishment of a representative democracy on Metellos, but elected officials remained under the influence of local corporate interests.<ref name="CATCW" /> The Empire besieged Metellos during [[Operation Shadow Hand]],<ref name="TTSP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref> and in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], an Imperial fleet led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sander Delvardus]] [[Battle of Metellos (Galactic Civil War)|engaged]] a New Republic defensive force on Metellos and bombarded the planet in a show of force, killing more than five billion people. The subsequent recovery of Metellos was slowed due to the New Republic's focus on repairing damage on Coruscant. During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|New Republic Fifth Battle Group]] used Metellos as a supply point as it attacked the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]].<ref name="CATCW" />

==Inhabitants==
Humans comprised 90% of Metellos's population of 900 billion, which made the planet among the most densely-populated in the galaxy. Overpopulation was the greatest problem that affected Metellos. The population was divided into two social classes: the [[Gentry/Legends|gentry]], who controlled the floating cities and the upper levels of the stratoblocks, and the [[groundpounder]]s, who consisted of datapushers, plant laborers, [[Con artist/Legends|con artists]], thieves, and indigents. [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] was spoken by the planet's inhabitants, who typically felt that their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was unimpressive by the standards of the Core Worlds.<ref name="CATCW" />
